newsitem.title: UK: Siemens sets euro Eurobonds in DEM, FRF, NLG.
newsitem.headline: Siemens sets euro Eurobonds in DEM, FRF, NLG.

text.p: Siemens Coordination Center SA has launched three 10-year Eurobonds, in French francs, guilders and marks, which will be redenominated in euros after EMU, J.P. Morgan said as joint lead manager on all three deals.
There is a 750 million mark deal to be priced at a 17 basis points spread over Bunds, a 2.5 billion franc deal to be priced 14 b.p. over OATs and a 500 million guilder deal to be priced 20 b.p. over.
The deals are guaranteed by Siemens AG.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is also joint lead manager on all three deals. ABN AMRO Hoare Govett is joint lead on guilders and Paribas on francs.
Final pricing was due by 1030 GMT.
